title: Unit Event — Chasing The Sparkle Beyond the Blue Sky — Episode7 Chasing The Light

meta.Event: Chasing The Sparkle Beyond the Blue Sky
meta.Event Outline: Feeling the need for further practice leading up to their solo show, MORE MORE JUMP! decide to do a training camp that doubles as a streaming project. They start doing a variety of exercises under a special program devised by Airi, but something seems to be worrying Minori...

rows.Line: A few hours later
Beach

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you all for watching!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That concludes the second half of our training stream!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I can't believe how much your dancing improved!>
<I'm so excited about your solo show now!>
<Can you girls do a night stream for us?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Well, we may or may not be doing a surprise night stream later on, so stay tuned!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Oh no! I won't have time to take a bath!>
<Please archive this!>
<^^^ They said they'd archive everything a little earlier.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And a special thanks to all those who stayed with us in real time for the whole stream.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
We'll see you guys again real soon.
Until then, everyone...

rows.Speaker: Airi, Haruka, Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line: Good night!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Nice work, everyone! The second half went really well...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It wasn't easy, but I'm glad we all hung in there until the end.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Me too!
However, after working out and doing stuff all day... I'm exhausted...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, let's start recovering by taking a nice dip in the hot springs.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, yes!
I've been looking forward to that ever since I heard that they had them here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, you can all go on ahead without me. I'm gonna stay here and take a look around.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Is there something you need to do?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I'm just going for a walk.
This might be my only chance to go for a stroll along the beach at night, you know?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay...
In that case, we'll go on ahead without you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sure thing!
Have fun at the hot springs!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah...
This is nice. The sea seems so much more mysterious at night.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And this breeze feels really great...
It might've been fun to play with some fireworks during our stream...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hm?
I thought you went to the hot springs with the others.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I was...
But I felt like joining you after you said you'd be going for a walk.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Uh, okay?
As long as you're fine with that, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Still, isn't this a beautiful view...?
What we saw at dusk was also nice, but I really love seeing the sea at night.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, so do I.
I have a feeling that more than a few people would really enjoy it if we were to stream what we're seeing now...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, I was just thinking the same thing!
Let's see what Haruka and Minori think once they get back from the hot springs!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, I can't believe how well our stream went. We made it into the rankings for something, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I couldn't believe it either. It was only for a second, but we flew up the charts for our streaming platform!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We have you to thank for picking out where we'd be staying and coming up with all these fun training activities, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I appreciate it, but I really didn't do anything all that special. Our stream did so well because all of you made it so.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As far as training goes, it probably felt good in the end because you all made a real effort.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, we all put in a great effort!
When we rode the banana boat, smashed watermelons...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of which... Just a little earlier, when we were streaming our dance training, Minori really surprised me...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, that time...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, this is today's final training activity! We gotta dance like we mean it and show everyone just how far we've all come!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I hope Minori remembers what we discussed a little earlier...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (If she figured out how to put it into practice... She's gonna shine just that much brighter!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Think about who you want to reach...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Minori...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Yeah, that's it...!
Just keep that up through the chorus and...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Is Minori...?
Yes, this is different from how she normally moves...!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It's like she's brimming with energy...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(And looking somewhere very far away...
But where...? Beyond the camera...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Oh, what if she's trying to see everyone who's watching us...?!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Beautiful...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (She's trying so hard to reach everybody that it's causing her to shift her center of gravity forward and tilt off her axis.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (The way she's dancing is probably the most unrefined I've seen up to this point... But at the same time, she looks...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I don't quite understand why, but she looks...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (So cute...!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Everyone really seemed to enjoy the way Minori danced that time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yeah!
A ton of them even left comments saying, “I think Minori and I just made eye contact!”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I had a feeling that Minori was looking into the camera at everyone watching while I was dancing next to her.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That must've been because of the advice you gave her. By the way, what did you tell her?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I just told her about something from my past.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Your past...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I told her about this trick for bringing out the most cuteness in me that I thought of when I was still a trainee.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Really...?!
That explains why Minori was so dazzling.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A trick for bringing out the cuteness in you... I'm sure it's very effective since you're the one who came up with it, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Would you mind teaching it to me sometime?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure, but I'm not really sure that it'll do you much good.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It won't? Why not?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori and I are pretty similar, but nothing like you, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh...? Are we that different...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yes, we are.
It's why we have to think differently in terms of how we move our bodies when we dance. It even applies to how we each sing and speak.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
For example, look...
Your hands are completely different from mine.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yours are spindly and elegant...
While mine...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
They're round...
Like manju, you know?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which is why the little trick for me and Minori is...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Please... Don't say things like that.
I like your hands just the way they are, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Because they're so kind and gentle. You use them to pull everyone in the right direction, and I'm sure Minori felt the same way today... Also...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Here's a towel. Now dry those tears, already. A pretty face like yours should have a smile on it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're in this idol thing together now. But don't think I'm gonna let you beat me, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Even when I was feeling so awful, Airi, you were there to give me not just that fluffy towel but also the courage to stand back up.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's why I like your hands so much. They're so kind, gentle and soft...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So please, don't forget the fact that your hands have given others quite a bit of courage.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I really wasn't expecting you to say anything like that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm saying this because I've been looking up to you ever since we were still in training.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: During dance lessons, the trainer had to keep pointing out all the mistakes I was making... While you always seemed to be able to learn a dance right away.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It became clear to me that you practiced more than anybody else, and I thought that was really cool...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You thought I was cool...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, and there's more.
Whenever we worked together, you were always very kind to the staff and kept a close eye on the audience.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I greatly admire your incredible work ethic, Airi. So, it doesn't matter if it's about just your hand, I won't tolerate any put-downs of you, even from you yourself!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Because...
I've always been your fan.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks...
I always appreciate your kind words.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You've also been a source of encouragement for me, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Huh...?
I encouraged you...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I was bothered for the longest time about not having a stronger aura  ... But I realized later that being an idol involves more than just that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, even someone like me was able to inspire hope in others. Also...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
The idol that I really admired...
The idol that I thought I'd never be able to reach... She's saying that she's my fan.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which is why, Shizuku, I can't thank you enough...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As much as I struggled, I was able to keep going because you were there as my beacon. You were who I was chasing after.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was able to make it this far because of you, Shizuku. So, from the bottom of my heart, thank you...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, I should be thanking you for being so kind.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're one of my favorite idols, Airi, as well as my role model...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You've been that ever since the day we met...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe...
I guess that means we've been inspiring hope in each other this whole time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Next, let's spread that hope to our fans.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Right.
We have to tell everyone just how much we appreciate them during our solo show...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And do our best to inspire more and more hope in more and more people!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes!
